warnings.message: @examples/code-reviewer isn't offered for Cursor: its manifest turns that target off.
@examples/format-on-edit's command uses an $RMK_ variable; Cursor passes the event as JSON on stdin instead, so the hook has to read it from there.
Skills don't take arguments, so @examples/review-diff's placeholders stay in its text, with a note saying what each one is.
Cursor plugins can't set the CLI's permissions, so that part of @examples/safe-git was left out.
